import json,os,sys,time
from unittest.mock import patch
import numpy as np
import torch
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd())
from examples.huggingface.sft import prepare,tokenizer,texts
from examples.huggingface.validation import add_reference_adapters,audit
from examples.huggingface.mixed_precision import _Product,reference_projections
from examples.huggingface.reference_losses import stable_token_loss
from examples.lora.mlx_runtime import register_library,session
out='/tmp/onnax-real-nf4-bf16-accumulation-control.json'
if os.path.exists(out):raise SystemExit('Output already exists')
torch.set_num_threads(1)
register_library('/tmp/onnax-lifetimes-target/release/libonnxruntime_mlx_ep.dylib')
model,reference=prepare(True,mode='joint',nf4=True,projection_precision='bf16',session_factory=session)
reference=reference_projections(add_reference_adapters(reference,model))
tok=tokenizer(True)
batch={k:v for k,v in tok(texts()[0],return_tensors='pt').items() if k in ('input_ids','attention_mask')}
batch['labels']=batch['input_ids'].clone()
report={'scope':'Identical ONNX parameters and input; diagnostic reference accumulation intervention only','rtol':1e-4,'atol':1e-6,'input_ids':batch['input_ids'].tolist(),'states':{}}
def emulated(ctx,a,b):
 qa,qb=a.to(torch.bfloat16).float(),b.to(torch.bfloat16).float()
 ctx.save_for_backward(qa,qb)
 return (qa@qb).to(torch.bfloat16).float()
for state in ('initial','trained_30'):
 if state=='trained_30':
  with np.load('/tmp/onnax-qwen-real-nf4-bf16-lifetimes-30/export/adapter.npz') as values,torch.no_grad():
   for name,param in zip(model.onnx.names,model.onnx.adapters,strict=True):param.copy_(torch.from_numpy(values[name]))
 rows={}
 for control in ('native_bf16','fp32_accumulation'):
  with patch.object(_Product,'forward',emulated) if control=='fp32_accumulation' else __import__('contextlib').nullcontext():
   rows[control]=audit(model,reference,batch,diagnose_rounding=True,reference_loss=stable_token_loss)
  print(state,control,rows[control]['logits_max_abs'],len(rows[control]['gradient_failures']),flush=True)
 report['states'][state]=rows
 with open(out,'w') as f:json.dump(report,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
conclusion: FP32 accumulation control resolves the captured first-projection differences but not full-model logits/loss/gradient qualification at either parameter state.
